title: Otter waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='42' ry='9' fill='#2f7fd6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#4aa3e8'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='21' ry='22' fill='#8a5a33'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='71' rx='13' ry='16' fill='#c99a63'/>
  <!-- left arm resting -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='72' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8a5a33'/>
  <!-- right arm waving up -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='50' rx='6' ry='13' transform='rotate(25 72 50)' fill='#8a5a33'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='39' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#a06c40'/>
  <!-- fingers hint -->
  <circle cx='73' cy='34' r='2.2' fill='#a06c40'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='33' r='2.2' fill='#a06c40'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='35' r='2.2' fill='#a06c40'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#8a5a33'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#e0b98a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='26' r='4' fill='#8a5a33'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='26' r='4' fill='#8a5a33'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='36' r='3.2' fill='#20122a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='36' r='3.2' fill='#20122a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='35' r='1' fill='#b9e6ff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='35' r='1' fill='#b9e6ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='3.2' ry='2.4' fill='#3a2414'/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M45 47 Q50 51 55 47' stroke='#5a3a20' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M38 44 L30 42 M38 47 L30 48 M62 44 L70 42 M62 47 L70 48' stroke='#e8dcc8' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
